クラス Trigonometry

java.lang.Object
snippet.num.Trigonometry
public final class Trigonometry extends Object
A snippet for numerical operations on trigonometric functions.

    • sinpi

      public static double sinpi(double x)
      Calculate sin(pi * x).
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      sin(pi * x)

    • cospi

      public static double cospi(double x)
      Calculate cos(pi * x).
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      cos(pi * x)

    • tanpi

      public static double tanpi(double x)
      Calculate tan(pi * x).
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      tan(pi * x)

    • asinpi

      public static double asinpi(double x)
      Calculate asin(x) / pi. Return NaN if |x| > 1. A range of returned value y is -1/2 <= y <= 1/2.
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      asin(x) / pi

    • acospi

      public static double acospi(double x)
      Calculate acos(x) / pi. Return NaN if |x| > 1. A range of returned value y is 0 <= y <= 1.
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      acos(x) / pi

    • atanpi

      public static double atanpi(double x)
      Calculate atan(x) / pi. A range of returned value y is -1/2 <= y <= 1/2.
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      atan(x) / pi

    • sinc

      public static double sinc(double x)
      Calculate sinc(x) = sin(x) / x.
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      sinc(x) = sin(x) / x

    • sincpi

      public static double sincpi(double x)
      Calculate normalized sinc: sinc(pi * x) = sin(pi * x) / (pi * x).
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      sinc(pi * x) = sin(pi * x) / (pi * x)

      public static double cosm1(double x)

      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
      cos(x) - 1

    • cosm1pi

      public static double cosm1pi(double x)
      Calculate cos(pi * x) - 1.
      パラメータ:
      x - x
      戻り値:
